name: Kolkar Village
summary: Kolkar Village was once the central seat of power for the Kolkar centaur clan in Desolace. Nestled along the eastern bluffs between Sargeron and Magram Village, the settlement now lies captured by their bitter rivals, the Magram clan.

sections.title: A Fallen Stronghold
sections.body: The Kolkar are among the most widespread and prolific centaur clans across Kalimdor, commanding outposts and raiding parties throughout Durotar and the Barrens. Despite their broad reach, their ancestral seat of power in eastern Desolace was overrun and conquered by the brutal Magram clan. The loss of Kolkar Village dealt a severe blow to the clan's standing in the region, leaving the settlement in hostile rival hands while the remaining Kolkar fight to maintain their scattered footholds across central Kalimdor.

faq.q: Who controls Kolkar Village right now?
faq.answer: Despite its name, the village is currently occupied and controlled by the Magram clan of centaur, who conquered it from the Kolkar.

faq.q: Where are the Kolkar centaur now?
faq.answer: While ousted from this stronghold, the Kolkar clan remains widespread across central Kalimdor, maintaining active encampments and raiding territories across both Durotar and the Barrens.

faq.q: Why was taking Kolkar Village such a significant victory?
faq.answer: Kolkar Village served as the primary center of power for the Kolkar in Desolace. Because the Kolkar were the most prolific clan on the continent, seizing their heartland was a massive strategic blow orchestrated by their rivals.
Kolkar Village lies along the eastern cliffs of Desolace, situated directly between the ruins of Sargeron to the north and Magram Village to the south.

angles.text: The centaur clans have hounded the nomadic tauren for generations; watching the Kolkar lose their Desolace stronghold to inter-clan warfare offers a grim measure of relief to shu'halo travelers.
Horde scouts traveling through the Barrens and Durotar are well acquainted with the aggressive Kolkar, making the news of their lost center of power in Desolace strategically valuable.
